ObjectName.value: Mecz piłkarski Wisła Kraków - Zagłębie Sosnwoiec, 28 października 2022, Pożegnanie Stadionu Ludowego, KP

Categories.value: Panoramas|Stadion Ludowy in Sosnowiec|Self-published work|Association football matches in Poland|Stitched panoramic photographs|On OSM|Files with coordinates missing SDC location of creation|2022 in Sosnowiec|Matches of Wisła Kraków|Wikigrant WG 2024-18|2022 photos by Krzysztof Popławski|Matches of Zagłębie Sosnowiec

ImageDescription.value: Association football match between Zagłębie Sosnowiec and Wisła Kraków at Stadion Ludowy in Sosnowiec, Silesian Voivodeship, Poland, on 28 October 2022. The panoramic photograph shows a night view from the covered stand during the official farewell to Stadion Ludowy as Zagłębie Sosnowiec’s match stadium before the opening of the Zagłębie Sports Park. The frame includes packed stands, an illuminated football pitch, players, substitutes’ benches, away supporters’ sector, roof structure, floodlights, stairs, railings, stewards, supporters’ banners and the night-time atmosphere of the match.
